# KuroCat Skin Workshop & Community Plaza

> Official web editor and community gallery for KuroCat desktop pet skins (`.kurocat`), 2.5D sticker accessories, and custom keyboard skins (`.kurokb`).

## Links
- Skin Workshop & Plaza: https://workshop.kurocat.cc/
- KuroCat Official Homepage: https://kurocat.cc/
- Fast Direct Download Mirror: https://kurocat-download.app.workbuddy.host/?sharecode=JVAABIVZ7L
- KuroCat Source Repository: https://github.com/chanke17/KuroCat
- Workshop Source & PR Submissions: https://github.com/chanke17/KuroCat-Workshop

## Features
- Browser based 2.5D cat coat editor with photo color analysis, cubic bezier coat regions, shape tuning, and 2.5D sticker accessories.
- Free community gallery with real time interactive 2.5D previews, including Xiao Douni, Monster Hunter Dazed Cat (Palico), Brown Mackerel Tabby, Chinese Li Hua Tabby, Abyssinian, and custom 65% mechanical keyboard palettes.
- One click export to `.kurocat` or `.kurokb` for drag and drop import into KuroCat on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
